Description: The chamber smells faintly of old wood and candle wax, a reminder of countless feasts held here.
Red banners hang proudly, though the fabric is worn by time and whispers of past ceremonies.
Through the stained windows, moonlight sneaks in, painting the floor with pale blue light.
The tables are scarred with knife marks and stains — silent witnesses to banquets and quarrels alike.
A lone pumpkin rests on the side table, perhaps left from a harvest festival long forgotten.
Even in silence, the chamber feels alive with memories of kings, guests, and secrets shared in hushed tones.
